cards.name: Krookodile
cards.whyItBelongs: Krookodile is propped against a palm trunk on a moonlit beach with its arms folded over its belly and its long tail stretched out across the sand. A full moon hangs over a calm sea, a shooting star streaks across the sky, and two little flowering cacti sit at the edge of the scene. Its black mask reads like a pair of sunglasses, so it’s hard to tell whether it’s fast asleep or just very good at looking relaxed. Either way, it has the look of someone who has decided the night is theirs and isn’t in a hurry.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.whyItBelongs: Pawmot has claimed the haystack for an afternoon nap, stretched out with its eyes closed and a wonderfully content little smile. Pawmo keeps watch nearby while Pawmi bounds around below, making Kouki Saitou’s sunny farm scene feel like one member of the family has decided playtime can continue without them.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.whyItBelongs: Questionably sleeping in a fever dream. Tomokazu Komiya’s psychedelic carnival is pure hallucinatory sleepwalk energy.

cards.name: Starly
cards.whyItBelongs: In the middle of a berry tree buzzing with activity, one Starly has somehow decided it’s nap time. While the rest of the flock eats, flies, and chatters around it, this little bird sits peacefully asleep on the branch, completely unbothered by the commotion. Saino Misaki turns a busy feeding frenzy into a perfect tiny stolen nap.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.whyItBelongs: Cozy nap sprawled on the living room rug. Teeziro crafts a warm architectural interior where a little squirrel sleeps like royalty.

cards.name: Jacq
cards.whyItBelongs: Research won. Jacq has fallen completely asleep at his desk, glasses still on, surrounded by books, loose papers, and the remnants of a long study session. Oswaldo KATO’s warm daylight and wonderfully cluttered workspace make this feel like the inevitable ending to an afternoon spent getting a little too absorbed in Pokémon biology.
